artworks.title: Project d'une Grotte (Plan for a Grotto)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate grotto design with intricate details including curling leaf motifs and scrolls. In the center is a seated female figure surrounded by other figures, set within a grand niche. A water fountain element and surrounding foliage enhance the design. The style appears to reflect the Rococo style of the 18th century.

artworks.title: Dessein d'une Fontaine orné avec les quatre Elements (Design for a Fountain Decorated with the Four Elements)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts an ornate fountain with Baroque-style architectural elements and decorative figures like putti and intricate carvings. A child-like figure stands on top of an archway, while others are positioned around the fountain, with lush foliage surrounding it. The fountain is adorned with a relief of a face, along with sculptures and engravings adding to its ornamental appearance.

artworks.title: Tolozan de Montfort
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving featuring the upper part of a man's body in a profile view. The man is facing to the right, displaying his head and upper chest. His facial details are intricate, with a prominent nose and a serene expression. His hair is styled in a curled fashion and tied at the back with a bow. He is dressed in a decorated coat and a high-collared, laced shirt. The drawing includes decorative elements like a floral and laurel wreath surrounding the man's profile in an oval frame. Beneath the frame, there is a sculpted mask and draped fabric. The background is textured with fine lines.

artworks.title: Annibale Carracci
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper, laid down
artworks.dimensions: overall (trimmed to plate mark): 13.2 x 10.7 cm (5 3/16 x 4 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait sketch of a man with a distinctive facial structure. His features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and slightly pursed lips. He has short, wavy dark hair and wears a dark coat with a white collar. The portrait features textured shading. The background has horizontal line patterns and the inscription "ANIBAL CARAS PICTOR" at the top.

artworks.title: Pierre Mignard
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person looking directly at the viewer. The person has a solemn expression with distinctive facial features and curly hair. They are dressed in elegant attire with a high collar. The background includes an oval frame around the figure and text mentioning the name "Pierre Mignard."

artworks.title: Satyr Carrying a Nymph
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures in a forest setting. The image displays a central figure that appears to have the features of a satyr, holding another creature on its shoulder. Another figure is near them, clutching an amphora, knee-deep in water. Surrounding them, lush vegetation with finely detailed foliage suggests a rich, dense forest. The texture and shading are composed of intricate lines and cross-hatching, giving depth and contrast to the scene.

artworks.title: Anton Raphael Mengs
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 25.2 x 20.6 cm (9 15/16 x 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing a man from the chest upwards. He has distinct facial features, including high cheekbones and a prominent forehead, with medium-length, wavy hair framing his face. The man is wearing a historical garment with a layered collar and a scarf around his neck. The background is a plain oval shape with dark texture, and the name "MENGS" is displayed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Marie-Thérèse-Charlotte, Duchess of Angoulême
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Piat Joseph Sauvage
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a woman in profile. She has delicate facial features and a gentle smile. Her curly hair is styled elaborately with a ribbon or headband, and she wears a lace collar. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate circular frame with floral and ribbon decorations at the top. Below the frame, there is a nameplate with inscriptions. The background is textured and dark within a rectangular border, giving the image a formal presentation.

artworks.title: Illusionistic Ceiling with a Grape Arbor, Figures Poised on Galleries, and a Central Scene of Olympian Gods
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white, over black chalk on brown paper (sheet enlarged at right and bottom by the artist)
artworks.description: The image features architectural designs and mythological figures. It displays a complex composition with segmented sections showcasing architectural elements like arches and columns, paired with mythological imagery. The upper part shows dynamic figures within swirling clouds and horses. In the center, there is a circular scene with additional figures in a sculptural arrangement. The right side is adorned with floral ornamentation and decorative patterns. The drawing reflects a style reminiscent of a Renaissance or Mannerist artist, emphasizing strong architectural forms and intricate mythical themes.

artworks.title: The "Canopus" of the Villa Adriana at Tivoli
artworks.medium: red chalk over black chalk on heavy laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This drawing is a view of an interior architecture scene similar to an ancient ruin. It is a large, vaulted space flanked by dilapidated walls. The structure features several arches, with some areas showing signs of decay and vegetation overgrowth. Farther back is an area that seems to open up slightly in the distance. The drawing's technique consists of loose, expressive lines with cross-hatching and shading. The lines are red on beige paper.

artworks.title: A Palatial Wall Ornamented with Sculptures and Paintings
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a complex architectural design with ornate decorative elements. The drawing shows the façade of a building or a conceptualized architectural structure featuring intricate details typical of classical architecture. It includes three levels adorned with sculptures set within niches, decorative cornices, and ornamental panels. The top section includes garlands, putti, and urns. Human figures in relief are depicted across the top two levels, enclosed in rounded niches, while more elaborate scenes with multiple figures are seen in two central panels on the middle level. The bottom portion of the structure is simpler with rectangular outlines. Thin pen lines and a light wash suggest that the drawing serves as a preparatory study or design proposal for an architectural project.

artworks.title: Mountain Torrents Flooding a City
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown-gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with cascading waterfalls, a city integrated into cliffs, jagged mountains, ancient architecture, loose and expressive brushstrokes, monochromatic sepia tones, figures in a boat on turbulent waters, and winding waterfalls leading to tall structures and rugged mountains.

artworks.title: Entrance to the Bowels of the Earth
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown-gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an underground scene with rocky cavern formations extending into the distance. The scene is rendered with earthy tones and fluid brushstrokes, capturing shadows and textures. Figures can be seen navigating the cave pathways, and in the distance, there are more figures and architectural features carved into the rock.

artworks.title: Piazza with an Equestrian Monument and a Palace
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite, squared in graphite for transfer, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a street-level view in the city, looking towards a wide open square surrounded by buildings. The horizon is low in the composition, aligned with the rooftops of the architecture. In the distance, a statue on a pedestal is visible in the center of the square. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, with fine lines defining the architecture and washes adding depth to the sky and structures. The color palette is monochromatic, using black, gray, and white. Buildings frame the view, with one featuring a cornice on the left and another with arched windows and intricate detailing on the right, partially in shadow. The sky is filled with varying gray tones, suggesting cloud cover.

artworks.title: A Palatial Garden with Circular Terraces
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite, squared in graphite, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a garden setting with tall trees framing the scene. Beyond the trees, there are staircases, pedestals, and columns. The horizon is obscured by foliage and architectural features. The artwork shows precise, linear brushstrokes with washes of ink creating texture and volume. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. The brushwork captures details of the elements in the scene.

artworks.title: River Rapids by Wooded Cliffs
artworks.medium: gray wash with white gouache over traces of black chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Ivan Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: The image is depicted from an elevated point of view, providing a broad perspective of the landscape. The horizon is positioned relatively high, showcasing distant rocky formations topped with trees. Just above the horizon, dense clouds stretch across the sky. The brushstrokes are smooth and consistent, giving a soft and cohesive texture to the elements within the scene. The overall color palette is dominated by a range of blues. Close to us, a wooden structure extends over a flowing body of water, where people can be seen. In the distance, rugged rock formations and tall, slender trees create a dramatic contrast against the expansive sky.

artworks.title: A Young Woman Overcome by Love [recto]
artworks.medium: black and red chalks with brown wash on buff laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing with intricate figures and abstract shapes, executed with loose brushwork. The color palette consists of browns and beiges. The lines suggest movement and activity. The central portion appears to show a gathering of figures. The background has swirling strokes, creating depth. The work carries an energetic atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Reclining Nude with Her Right Arm Raised over a Swift Composition Study [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk with touches of red chalk on buff laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a human figure, focusing on the upper body, head, and torso. The person is posed in a relaxed manner, facing the right side of the image with one arm slightly raised. The face has calm features, with a short swept-back hairstyle and loose curls framing the face. The figure is unclothed, and the background consists of abstract lines implying movement. There is no jewelry visible, and the drawing is done with various shades of pencil or charcoal to define the figure's outlines. The background is plain, with faint lines, emphasizing the figure's silhouette.

artworks.title: Pietà
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 39.8 x 28.5 cm (15 11/16 x 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure supported by two others. The central figure is seated and slumped forward, with eyes closed, head tilted, long hair, and a beard. They are unclothed in the upper body. One figure on the left leans over, wearing a head covering and robes. The figure on the right, with large wings, gently holds the central person's hand. The ground has a crown of thorns and rocks. The background features a tree with branches and leaves against a softly streaked sky.

artworks.title: View of Paris from the Terrace of the Pavillon de Brimborion
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with touches of white gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. John Jay Ide
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated viewpoint overlooking a landscape. In the foreground, three figures are seated on a stone platform, with one of them painting. An umbrella provides shade nearby, and potted plants are scattered around. The horizon separates the sky from the landscape below, where a river winds through buildings, fields, trees, and hills in the distance. The painting features detailed brushstrokes and a gentle color palette dominated by blues and greens, with touches of earthy tones and reds.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius in the style of Parmigianino
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 47.4 x 35.2 cm (18 11/16 x 13 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two women in full length, positioned facing each other. The woman on the left has braided hair and gazes towards the other woman. The woman on the right also has braided hair and seems to lean slightly towards her companion. Both women wear long robes. In the background is a large stone structure with an arched opening leading to classical architecture. In the foreground is a small dog. Another character in the background is walking away towards buildings with smoke coming from chimneys. The ground is paved with irregular stones.

artworks.title: The Circumcision
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius in the style of Albrecht Dürer
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 47.5 x 35.4 cm (18 11/16 x 13 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in a group scene. Central in the composition, a bearded man holds an infant with another elderly man reaching out towards the child. They are surrounded by other figures, including a woman. Several other figures are depicted, with detailed historical period attire. The background is an interior space with high arched ceilings and intricate architectural details, including a large chandelier and decorative items on a tray.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with John the Baptist
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman with two cherubic children. The woman is seated under a tree, draped in garments with her hair styled back. She holds one child on her lap while the other stands beside her. The woman has a serene expression. The background displays mountains, a body of water with boats, and a town near the water's edge. Ruins and pillars are visible in the scene.

artworks.title: Bust of a Bearded Old Man
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15.6 x 14.3 cm (6 1/8 x 5 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a man's head and upper shoulders in profile view. He is facing left with detailed facial features including wrinkles on his forehead and around his eyes, a pronounced nose, and a full beard. His hair is textured, receding at the top but bushy at the sides, with a somewhat curly or wavy appearance. The man wears a shirt with a wide, open collar and textured fabric, showing signs of wear. The background is plain and lightly textured.
